//coverImage: Round 1, at Teddy's request: a fresh one-pass Canva picture with a blank board (media MAHZ-9d0lPg, 1680x944), exported at 1920x1080 and cropped 1:1 to the cover panel, no AI upscaling, about 334 PPI. Repeated Canva edits plus Real-ESRGAN had smeared an earlier version; the chalk map was tried and dropped.
//synthesiseCover: The manuscript's cover page is three stacked copies of the title block ('RELIGIOUS' / 'EDUCATION' / 'FORM 3' on separate lines, twice with a stray 'Form' + '3' split), so the detected cover read 'RELIGIOUS' as the whole title, printed 'FORM 3' twice and put the imprint line 'Zambia Education Publishing House Lusaka' where the authors go. Built fresh from title/subject/book type instead.
//authors: The cover byline is one string of initials ('E.B. Mumba, S.M. Maseka, M.S. Yamba and E. N. Zimba'), which the author filter drops as too long, so the cover read AUTHORS with nobody under it. Kept in the manuscript cover's order, with each name as the AUTHORS bios spell it in full.
//bylineRows: Four authors do not fit on one line. Without this the title page split a name across lines ("Maybin" / "Simuchenje Yamba") and, once that was stopped, ended a line on a bullet and pushed "Lusaka" onto a page of its own. Sets the names two to a line.
//boxLabelBlankRuns: Topic 2's "End-of-Topic Assessment" label opens with an unformatted run of ten spaces before its bold text, so the engine read it as not bold and never boxed that assessment; this reads the label's weight from its first run with visible text instead. Opt-in, because other books carry the same residue on labels they were reviewed with unboxed.
//removeImages: image7/8/9 are tiny (about 0.2 inch) pictures of the numerals '1.', '2.', '3.' the author pasted beside the Exercise 1 questions in Sub-topic 2.1. edit.find: First, send messages to all schools, churches
edit.with: First, send messages to all schools, churches and organisations to invite parents in the district for the meeting on the weekend. For easy communication of the admission criteria, parents should be talked to in small groups according to the number of classes available. The parents are allowed to ask questions at the end of the presentation.

editAnswer.find: Since the school is the rural district the cutoff points for both the girls and boys should be lower than those in urban areas. There should be also a different cut-off points between girls and boys by having the cutting-off point for girls lower than the boys. This will give opportunity to girls to be in school and prevent poverty, early marriages, and other vices on the girl child.
